name: Alex Tan
introduction: I like turning curious ideas into thoughtful digital experiences, small experiments, and stories worth sharing.

about.title: A little more about me
paragraphs: I am a curious student who enjoys the space where creativity, technology, and people meet. I learn best by building things, asking questions, and sharing the process.
Away from a screen, you will probably find me taking photos, discovering new music, or planning the next small adventure with friends.
